systems.name: Arkansas Public Employees' Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 4).

source.quote: Act 177 of 1957 established a retirement system for employees of the state of Arkansas and created the APERS Board and its duties, organization, powers, and function.

website_source.quote: Is your agency or organization interested in joining the Arkansas Public Employees’ Retirement System?

covers_local_source.quote: Is your agency or organization interested in joining the Arkansas Public Employees’ Retirement System?

systems.notes: APERS staff also administer the Arkansas State Police and Arkansas Judicial retirement systems. Counties, municipalities and other public employers may join.

systems.name: Arkansas Teacher Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 7).

website_source.quote: Since 1937, the Arkansas Teacher Retirement System (ATRS) has been providing retirement benefits to Arkansas's public school and education employees.

systems.notes: Covers employees of local public school districts and other public education employers.

systems.name: Arkansas Local Police and Fire Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 10).

website_source.quote: LOPFI is a statewide defined benefit retirement system for police officers and firefighters of political subdivisions in Arkansas.

covers_local_source.quote: LOPFI is a statewide defined benefit retirement system for police officers and firefighters of political subdivisions in Arkansas.

systems.notes: Census reports the cost-sharing and agent-multiple-employer parts of LOPFI as two units.

systems.name: Arkansas State Highway Employees' Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 5).

website_source.quote: ARKANSAS STATE HIGHWAY EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM Room 405 – 10324 Interstate 30; Little Rock, AR 72209

systems.notes: Covers employees of the Arkansas Department of Transportation; its pages are hosted on the ARDOT site.

systems.name: Arkansas State Police Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 6).

source.quote: Act 311 of 1951 established a retirement system (ASPRS) for state troopers of the Arkansas State Police. This system is overseen by the ASPRS Board of Trustees (Board).

website_source.quote: Act 311 of 1951 established a retirement system (ASPRS) for state troopers of the Arkansas State Police.

systems.name: Arkansas Judicial Retirement System
systems.why: No Arkansas statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is governed by Ark. Code Ann. title 24, chapter 8).

source.quote: The administration and control of the system are vested in the Board of Trustees of AJRS (the Board).

website_source.quote: Act 365 of 1953 established a retirement system (AJRS) for circuit judges, court of appeals judges, and Arkansas Supreme Court justices.
